office.en: California Superintendent of Public Instruction, November 3, 2026 general election. Nonpartisan. Certified candidate list, August 27, 2026.

sourceTitle.en: California Secretary of State, Official Voter Information Guide for the November 3, 2026 General Election, certified August 10, 2026

spectrumNote.en: Nonpartisan ballot line; the statement used here is about public-school spending

summary.en: The voter guide says he brought people together to cut bureaucracy and invest in students and the classroom, and that he would protect public education from what he calls Trump and MAGA attacks. The classroom line does not choose between direct public-school funding and money that follows the child.

whyIncluded.en: The other superintendent candidate. His voter-guide statement talks about investing in public-school classrooms. It does not say whether public money should follow a child to a school the family picks, so it is not scored.
